AXTI is up over 100% since I first mentioned it. Here are two photonics stocks I’m watching.

Photonics is using light instead of copper wires to move data. It’s faster, more efficient, and it matters because AI servers have to constantly share huge amounts of data. Without lasers and optical links, these AI systems can’t scale.

Lumentum makes the laser and optical parts used inside data center connections. As AI data centers expand, they need more optical links to keep GPUs, servers, and networking gear communicating at full speed, and Lumentum supplies key components for that buildout.

AXTI makes indium phosphide, the specialty material used to build the tiny lasers inside data centers. I already own it and I want to buy more on dips in the 20s. AXTI supplies about a third of the world’s indium phosphide, with only one other company of similar size, so supply is tight and pricing can move as demand grows.
